C-HUB-V2.IntentSummary: Execute the Hub v2 spec approved on 2026-10-08: clean and freeze v1, then build v2 in its own package, then the cards and views, and publish both versions together.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The spec and the design context are committed; the draft redesign is superseded.

Registry and portfolio records of v1 carry no names, decisions, approvals or decision dates, all Draft or Proposed; the charter's references to Decision Records are replaced by a dash; v1 builds, and a scan finds no name, no DR identifier and no approved state; a Draft status shows on every page.

v1 moves to aicc/v1 as a self-contained package that builds into html/aicc/v1 and is identical to the cleaned build; the chooser exists at html/aicc; the source files of v1 are published under its root without its decision records.

aicc/v2 holds the forked shell and tooling with Russian as the source language, the Draft status chip, the page id beside the title, the term-with-English convention, the Hub names, and the publishing of its own source files.
The Hub intent pages, the vocabulary RU (EN), the process pages (levels, states, forums, roles, profiles) and the carried Discovery catalog exist in Russian with no reference to v1.
The card schema, template and validation exist; the existing initiatives and the HR and Compliance run-rate work are cards; Funnel, Portfolio and Program are rendered from cards.
All checks and browser checks pass for both versions; the package is published with the chooser; the default stays v1 until the owner switches it.
